description: PB-68 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Dhar Kalan subdivision in the Pathankot district of Punjab. Operated under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), this office handles vehicle registration, driving licenses, and local transport administrative duties for the hilly border regions of the state.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Dhar Kalan, Pathankot, Punjab
